correctness.rationale: The exact finite Stirling transition yields the departure probabilities. For fixed k, inclusion-exclusion gives q_nk~k((k-1)/k)^n. The bound on conditional skipping from a larger state is binom(l,k-1)((k-1)/(l-1))^n, hence all fixed low levels are visited with probability 1-o(1). The self-loop count at each visited level is an independent geometric variable, giving the joint exponential limit. The exact k=2 and k=3 escape rates, together with sum_{k>=4}1/q_nk <= n(4/3)^n, establish E[T]=2^(n-1)+(3/2)^n/3+O(n(4/3)^n); a 625-test exact arithmetic checker corroborates finite formulas but is not an infinite proof.
